[[Scratcher]] is a [[Harpy]] [[boss]] that appears in the [[Wilderness of Bahdza]] only before the completion of the [[quest]] [[Destroy the Harpies]] and during [[Population Control]] as one of the Harpy bosses you have to kill. After defeating this boss, all nearby harpies will cease attacking you and flee to [[Resplendent Makuun]].
